noLibraryItems: No library items match these filters.
libraryItemNotFound: That library item was not found.
libraryDescription: Pull media library metadata from selected libraries.
parityDescription: Create users and libraries to match the main source.
parityLinkHint: To link users: click their name in the main source column and then the listener column(s)
parityLibraryLinkHint: To link libraries: click their name in the main source column and then the listener column(s)
mustLinkMainSource: Link from the main source item to a listener item.
usersDescription: Create the selected main source users on listener apps.
historyDescription: Sync watch history for the selected users.
historyNeedsLibraryData: Sync library metadata before running history sync.
historyWaitingForLibrary: Waiting for library sync to finish.
syncTypeDescription: Library pulls media library data with no user watch data. Users syncs watch status.
queuedCheckedEveryMinute: Queued items are checked every minute
automationEnabledDescription: When enabled, this sync runs automatically on the interval below.
noLogs: No log files have been generated yet.
selectLogToView: Select a log from the left to view
backupTimeDescription: Daily time to dump the database into /config/backups. Times are in 10 minute steps.
backupKeepDescription: Housekeeper removes backup folders older than this many days.
resetHistoryDescription: Remove stored watch history for the selected users. This only deletes Watchsync data. It does not change Plex, Emby, or Jellyfin.
resetHistoryConfirm: Remove stored watch history for the selected users?
deleteLocalLibraryDescription: Remove movies, series, and episodes stored in Watchsync for the selected libraries. Linked watch history for that media is removed too. This does not change Plex, Emby, or Jellyfin.
deleteLocalLibraryConfirm: Delete local Watchsync data for the selected libraries, including linked watch history?
deleteLocalLibraryComplete: Local library data removed. Movies: {0}, series: {1}, episodes: {2}.
noLocalLibraries: No local libraries with paths are stored yet. Sync My media first.
browseDatabaseInvalidTable: That table is not available to browse.
browseDatabaseQuerySingleOnly: Only a single query is allowed.
backupQueuedNote: A backup is queued for the next cron run.
deleteBackupConfirm: Delete this backup? This cannot be undone.
restoreBackupConfirm: Restore this backup? All current database tables will be dropped and replaced with the backup. This cannot be undone.
visitDiscord: Get some help if the wiki does not cover it
mediaAppsPlaceholder: Connect Plex, Emby, and Jellyfin here. Setup is coming soon.
mediaAppsDescription: Add Plex, Emby, and Jellyfin servers to sync watch status. One app is the main source and the others listen.
addAnotherMediaApp: Add another Plex, Emby, or Jellyfin server.
noMediaApps: No media apps yet. Add one to get started.
name: Name
needOnlineMediaApps: At least 2 media apps must be online to sync.
plexTokenDescription: An admin Plex token is required so Watchsync can list every user. See https://support.plex.tv/articles/204059436
apiKeyDescription: Emby and Jellyfin API key from Dashboard > Settings > API Keys. An admin key is required to list users. username:password can be used if you cannot create a key.
mediaAppUrlDescription: Server URL, for example http://192.168.1.10:32400 or http://192.168.1.10:8096
syncModeDescription: Push (Watchsync → Media app). Pull (Media app → Watchsync). Both (Watchsync ↔ Media apps).
mainSourceDescription: The main source is the master. Other apps are listeners.
mainSourceConvertNote: NOTE: Setting this as the main source will convert the current main source to a listener
mediaAppInvalidToken: The token or API key was rejected.
mediaAppInvalidUrl: The URL was not a media server API.
mediaAppConnectionFailed: Could not connect to the media app.
mediaAppUsersFailed: Connected, but could not list users. Use an admin token or API key.
missingConnectionFields: URL and token or API key are required.
mustHaveMainSource: One media app must stay marked as the main source.
noMediaAppUsers: No users were returned for this app.
tokenInvalid: Token was rejected by the server.
pinNotChecked: Pin could not be checked and was not saved.
historySkipMissingPin: Skipped {0} because a pin is required and none is saved.
syncSkipDeletedUser: Skipped {0} because the user was deleted.
historyFallbackMissingPin: Using history for {0} because a pin is required and none is saved.
parityRemotePlexPasswordNote: Note: Newly created users based on Plex remote accounts will have {0} as their password.
loginSettingDescription: Login required always asks for a password. Login off disables login. Login bypass trusts an auth proxy header from trusted networks.
loginUpstreamsDescription: Only direct connections from these networks can use login bypass. Put your reverse proxy or LAN CIDRs here.
loginAllowPrivateDescription: Trust RFC1918 and unique-local IPv6 ranges (10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16, fc00::/7).
loginCustomUpstreamsDescription: CIDR or IP list, separated by spaces or new lines. Bare IPs are treated as /32 or /128.
loginAuthHeaderDescription: Header set by your auth proxy when using login bypass.
loginUpstreamsRequired: Choose localhost, private networks, or at least one custom network before using login bypass.
syncParitySettingsDescription: When new users or libraries appear on the main source with no links, parity can add them to listener apps.
syncParityAutoUsers: Automatically add new users to listeners
syncParityAutoUsersDescription: Select new unlinked main source users and create them on listener apps during automatic parity.
syncParityAutoLibraries: Automatically add new libraries to listeners
syncParityAutoLibrariesDescription: Select new unlinked main source libraries and create them on listener apps during automatic parity.
syncLibrarySettingsDescription: Control how new libraries are included in metadata pulls.
syncLibraryAutoMetaDescription: When a new library appears, include it in automatic metadata pulls.
syncHistorySettingsDescription: Control how new users and new library items are included in history sync.
syncHistoryNewUsersDescription: Include newly added main source users in automatic history sync.
syncHistoryNewLibrariesDescription: After new library metadata is pulled, automatically sync watch history for it.
logLevelDescription: Debug includes extra detail in sync logs when supported.
cronLogLengthDescription: How long to keep cron and sync job log files (min 1 day).
systemLogLengthDescription: How long to keep system log files (min 1 day).
webhookLogLengthDescription: How long to keep webhook log files (min 1 day).
logRotateDescription: Active log files rotate automatically at {0} MB.
fillInPasswordFields: Fill in the current, new, and confirm password fields to change your password.
passwordsDoNotMatch: New password and confirmation do not match.
passwordMinLength: Password must be at least 6 characters.
usernameAlreadyInUse: That username is already in use.
notificationsNotSetup: Notifications have not been setup yet, click the plus icon above to set them up.
clearSyncHistoryConfirm: Delete all sync history and logs? This cannot be undone.
deleteSyncHistoryConfirm: Delete this sync history and log? This cannot be undone.
senderNameDescription: The name of this notification sender
webhookApiKeyDescription: Required on every inbound webhook. An empty or mismatched key is rejected.
webhookUrlDescription: Use this same URL in Plex, Emby, and Jellyfin.
webhookUrlEventsNote: Note: Plex sends all webhooks but for Emby/Jellyfin you have to pick them. Pause, Stop, Finish, Item added, Mark watched & Mark unwatched (whichever they support) is what you want to check.
clearWebhookLogsConfirm: Delete all webhook logs? This cannot be undone.
deleteWebhookLogConfirm: Delete this webhook log? This cannot be undone.
